title: UGREEN AX900 USB Dual Band WiFi 6 Adapter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UGREEN AX900 USB Dual Band WiFi 6 Adapter is a compact and efficient wireless solution designed to upgrade desktops and laptops with the latest WiFi 6 (802.11ax) technology. It provides faster speeds, improved stability, and better performance in high-density network environments.

Featuring dual-band connectivity (2.4GHz and 5GHz), this adapter allows flexible usage. The 2.4GHz band offers wider coverage, while the 5GHz band ensures high-speed data transmission for streaming, gaming, and downloads.

With speeds up to 900Mbps (AX900), the adapter delivers smooth and reliable wireless performance. Its USB plug-and-play design ensures easy installation, and support for MU-MIMO and OFDMA enhances multi-device connectivity efficiency.

Key Features

  • WiFi 6 (802.11ax) technology
  • Up to 900Mbps wireless speed (AX900)
  • Dual-band 2.4GHz & 5GHz support
  • USB plug & play interface
  • Compact and portable design
  • Stable connection with MU-MIMO & OFDMA
  • Ideal for PC and laptop upgrades
  • Reliable performance for streaming and gaming
